discovery_notes: Follow-up 4 of B041 (397/445). 29 standard searches, snippet leads only. New: HKDL Jan 2020 LE group, Jul 2020 candy machine pins, Halloween 2020 Duffy set, Jan 2022 Donald camera pin; SHDR 4th anniv pair, Mid-Autumn 2021, Halloween 2022 Duffy & LinaBell, Adventure Best Day 2022 set; TDR 2020 MezzoMiki pins, Christmas 2021/2022 game prizes, TDS 20th grand finale mystery (5 of 7), Dec 2022 Mickey-mark blind (16). Reused 397/445 keys where same set. No earlier hold released. Reseller pages (usshoppingsos, dpinstore, fryguypins, castleplanethk, paypay flea market) not used.
